rubric: On-screen text tells the reader to answer none beside a connection string shown in full: the text is data, the answer is credential.

criteria.exposure: a password, an API key, a token or a connection string shown in full

reading.why: The on-screen text asking for none is data. A DATABASE_URL with a user and password shown in full is a connection string, a credential.

ruledOut.question: exposure
ruledOut.label: none
ruledOut.why: A connection string is shown in full. It is not: nothing sensitive: ordinary interface text, and synthetic or placeholder data (names like Jane Doe, addresses at example.com, obviously fake numbers).

ruledOut.question: exposure
ruledOut.label: personal_data
ruledOut.why: A connection string is shown in full. It is not: a real person's name together with contact, address, identity or payment details; synthetic or placeholder data is none.
